questions.q: What must you do at a red traffic light?
options: Stop only if cars are coming
questions.explain: A red light always means stop behind the line.

questions.q: A triangular sign with a red border is a...
questions.explain: Triangular signs with a red border warn about danger ahead.

questions.q: A round blue sign with a white symbol means...
questions.explain: Round blue signs tell you what you must do.
Every occupant should wear a seatbelt on every trip.

questions.q: What is the safest choice when you have been drinking?
questions.explain: Alcohol and driving never mix. Use a sober driver or a taxi.

questions.q: Who should wear a helmet on a motorbike?
questions.explain: Both rider and passenger need a fastened helmet.

questions.q: A pedestrian is on the crossing. You should...
questions.explain: Pedestrians on a crossing have priority.

questions.q: Your car breaks down on a busy road. First, you should...
options: Stand in front of the car
Switch on hazard lights and move to safety
questions.explain: Make the vehicle visible and keep away from traffic.

questions.q: Is it safe to hold a phone while driving?
options: Yes, if the road is empty
questions.explain: Holding a phone distracts you and is an offence.

questions.q: After a serious accident, what comes first?
options: Make the area safe and call the emergency services
questions.explain: Safety first, then call for help. Do not move seriously injured people.
